observation: Read the complete structured selection. A chain of explicit limitations drives method changes: conventional measures miss network features, KPP-NEG misses node order, Shapley/cohesion adds contributions but cannot handle directed networks, and basic PageRank mismatches a small citation network. A virtual outside-paper node and two weighting steps form the local repair. Results distinguish undirected coauthor/movie networks from directed citations; agreement of the top paper coexists with changes in other ranks. Sensitivity is asymmetric: Shapley rankings depend on sample size, PageRank rankings are said to be less sensitive to damping. Do not generalize this into universal robustness. ProblemClarification and ModelDesign are flattened into the first block while Results is separate; printed internal heading/paragraph structure needs source comparison. The page2title leaks after the ending. Author spelling variants Edros/free-scale and claims are preserved without editorial correction or mathematical checking.
